verdict.rationale: Notte documents its own path from one-shot prompts to repeatable automation. It supports hybrid scripting, where deterministic parts are scripted and AI is used only when needed. It can also generate workflow code from the CLI for editing, and deploy scripts as serverless Functions that can be invoked and scheduled. However, the evidence never shows explicit loop, conditional, or parameter constructs; control flow is only implied by writing code. Missing for 10: documented loop/conditional workflow primitives, parameterized Function inputs, worked multi-step workflow examples, independent hands-on corroboration.
